user.title: Energy entities
user.description: Pick the lifetime energy counters for your system. Each must be a sensor with a state class of total or total_increasing - a power sensor in watts will not work, because the report reads long-term statistics. Leave House load empty and one will be calculated for you from the others.

rates.title: Prices
rates.description: Point these at whatever holds your current price - a tariff sensor, or an entity from a planner. It does not have to be in the sensor domain; a mirror sensor will be created so the price is recorded and every kilowatt-hour can be valued at the rate in force when it flowed. The fallback is used only for periods from before that mirror existed.

delivery.title: Delivery and schedule
delivery.description: Which notify service to send through, for example notify.mobile_app_phone or telegram_bot.send_message. Leave it empty to use the generate service and deliver the message yourself. The daily report can wait for sunset when that falls after the chosen time.

data.arbitrage_gate: Only count savings when this entity...

error.not_a_total: That sensor has no long-term statistics. It needs a state class of total or total_increasing - pick the kWh counter, not the W power sensor.

init.title: Energy Report settings
init.description: Prices, delivery and schedule. The energy entities cannot be changed here: the house load counter accumulates from them, and swapping one would leave it part one system and part another.
